Scenario: Asking About Places & Opening Hours · Lesson: Asking Where Things Are · grammar (Subject + 在 + place)
units.source: "在" states location - "X 在 Y" means "X is at/in Y", the basic pattern for describing where something is.
units.translation: "在" indica ubicación: "X 在 Y" significa "X está en Y", el patrón básico para describir dónde está algo.

units.context: Scenario: Asking About Places & Opening Hours · Lesson: Asking Where Things Are · grammar (Subject + 在 + place)
units.source: Using 是 instead of 在 for location: "邮局是前面" is wrong - it must be "邮局在前面".
units.translation: Usar 是 en lugar de 在 para indicar ubicación: "邮局是前面" está mal; debe ser "邮局在前面".

units.context: Scenario: Asking About Places & Opening Hours · Lesson: Opening and Closing Hours · grammar (Verb + 着)
units.source: "着" after a verb marks that the resulting state is ongoing right now - "开着" means "(is) open (right now)".
units.translation: "着" después de un verbo marca que el estado resultante está en curso en este momento; "开着" significa "está abierto (ahora mismo)".

units.context: Scenario: Asking About Places & Opening Hours · Lesson: Opening and Closing Hours · grammar (Verb + 着)
units.source: Confusing 着 (ongoing state) with 了 (completed action) - 开了 would mean "opened" as an event, not "is currently open".
units.translation: Confundir 着 (estado en curso) con 了 (acción completada): 开了 significaría "se abrió" como evento, no "está abierto actualmente".
